guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice latency-90 and latency-50 rose by about 4467% and 3096% (z=+893 and +619), far more than any other series, and frontend latency rose as a downstream effect. Its only callee, productcatalogservice, is flat (latency-50 +8%), and there are no error logs, no error spans, and no CPU or memory anomalies, so the fault looks like injected delay in recommendationservice itself.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate recommendationservice for injected network delay or latency on its pod or node (e.g. tc/netem rules, sidecar or network policy changes), remove the delay source, and restart or reschedule the pod only if the delay persists. This is non-destructive.
